title: VKSU Ara Graduation UG Admission 2026-30 Online Form
intro: Veer Kunwar Singh University (VKSU) has Released Official Notification for Online Application form for Regular Undergraduate (UG)/ Graduation/ Degree Course (B.A/ B.Sc/ B.Com) For Academic Session 2026-30 for 4 year programme under Choice Based Credit System (CBCS). Check All Details, Like Age Limit, Eligibility Details, Post Information, Pay Scale, Selection Process & More Details Related to VKSU Ara UG Admission. Online Apply Start On June 10, 2026 & Last Date for Application is June 16, 2026. All Eligible & Interested Candidates Can Read Full Notification Before Apply Online Now in the Given Link Below.
importantDates: Admission Date on the 1st Merit List :June - July 2026
Payment Mode: Pay the Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking Fee Mode
UG Arts: Candidates who have passed intermediate examination I.A./ I.Sc./ I.Com or +2 of Bihar School Examination Board or equivalent examination offered by other approved National / State Board
UG Science: Candidates who have passed intermediate examination I.A./ I.Sc./ I.Com or +2 of Bihar School Examination Board or equivalent examination offered by other approved National / State Boards.

UG Commerce: Candidates who have passed intermediate examination I.Sc. or +2 Science Stream only of Bihar School Examination Board or equivalent examinations offered by other approved National / State Boards.
UG Arts / Science / Commerce: Passed 10+2 (Intermediate) or equivalent from Bihar School Examination Board or any recognized board.
